meta.title: 竖屏视频黄金区一眼看懂
meta.title_en: The Golden Zone for Vertical Video at a Glance

scenes.title_cn: 开场：拍竖屏视频时，这个地方是最关键…
scenes.title_en: Opening: when shooting vertical video, thi…
scenes.context: 竖屏视频的关键区域讲解。
sentences: 拍竖屏的时候，这个地方是最关键的区域。
When shooting vertical video, this area is the most critical zone.
critical zone（关键区域）
今天更深入，这就是我们应该的地方。
Today we go deeper—this is where you should be.
go deeper（深入讲）
scenes.speak: When shooting vertical video, this area is the most critical zone. Today we go deeper—this is where you should be.

scenes.title_cn: 第一个原因：很多人看你的视频在手机上…
scenes.title_en: Reason one: many people watch your video o…
sentences: 很多人看你的视频在手机上，研究显示百分之七十五的人竖着拿手机。
Many watch on their phone—studies show 75% hold it vertically.
75% hold vertically（75%竖持）
所以你需要把视频描述挤下来，贴合观众的方式。
So you need to squeeze your description down to fit the viewer.
fit the viewer（贴合观众）
scenes.speak: Many watch on their phone—studies show 75% hold it vertically. So you need to squeeze your description down to fit the viewer.

scenes.title_cn: 字幕位置：你的字幕要放在这里，但一定…
scenes.title_en: Subtitle placement: put your subtitles her…
scenes.context: 字幕要避开平台 UI 遮挡区。
sentences: 你的字幕要放在下面，但一定要确保不要超过这条线。
Put your subtitles lower, but make sure they don't cross this line.
stay above the line（在线之上）
因为这里会是你的进度条和点赞栏，它会盖上来。
Because the progress bar and like bar sit here and cover it.
cover it up（盖上来）
paraphrase: stay above the line（在线之上
stay above the line（在线之上
scenes.speak: Put your subtitles lower, but make sure they don't cross this line. Because the progress bar and like bar sit here and cover it.

scenes.title_cn: 这里会是点赞、留言、分享的区域，所以…
scenes.title_en: This is where likes, comments, and shares …
scenes.context: 互动按钮区域同样是遮挡区。
sentences: 因为这里会是点赞、留言、分享的区域。
This is where likes, comments, and shares live.
likes and shares（点赞分享）
所以你必须要很小心。
So you have to be very careful.
be careful（要小心）
scenes.speak: This is where likes, comments, and shares live. So you have to be very careful.

scenes.title_cn: 最后一个重点：你的眼睛应该在这里。不…
scenes.title_en: The last and most important point: your ey…
scenes.context: 眼睛保持在黄金区域是关键。
sentences: 最后一个和最重要的：你的眼睛应该在这里。
The last and most important: your eyes should be here.
eyes in the golden zone（眼睛在黄金区）
不管从哪个角度拍，你的眼睛要在这里。
No matter the angle, your eyes go here.
no matter the angle（无论哪个角度）
这就是你会把视频弄得很舒服，让人看个不停。
That's what makes your video comfortable and keeps people watching.
keeps them watching（让人看不停）
paraphrase: eyes in the golden zone（眼睛在黄金区）
eyes in the golden zone（眼睛在黄金区）
scenes.speak: The last and most important: your eyes should be here. No matter the angle, your eyes go here. That's what makes your video comfortable and keeps people watching.

practice: Seventy-five percent hold their phone vertically.
Keep subtitles above the progress bar line.
Likes, comments, and shares cover the bottom.
Your eyes should stay in the golden zone.
pitfalls: Design for the 75% who hold their phone vertically.
Place subtitles near the bottom edge.
Keep subtitles above the progress-bar line.
字幕会被进度条和点赞栏遮住。
Put your face anywhere in the frame.
Keep your eyes in the golden zone from any angle.
眼睛始终保持在黄金区域。
Leave room for likes, comments, and shares.
预留互动按钮区域，避免遮挡。
shifts: 用 golden zone（黄金区）、critical area（关键区域）、safe line（安全线）
用 subtitle placement（字幕位置）、stay above the line（在线之上）
用 75% vertically（75%竖持）、cover up（遮挡）、keep watching（看不停）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：关键区域、75%竖持手机、字幕位置、进度条、点赞栏、点赞留言分享区、眼睛黄金区、看个不停等。
